shellCommands.command: find . -maxdepth 2 -not -path '*/node_modules*' -not -path '*/.git*' | sort && echo "---package.json---" && cat package.json
find /workspace/app/product -type f | sort
cat /workspace/__agent_eval__/run.mjs 2>/dev/null | head -100
npm ls next react react-dom 2>&1 | head -20 && node -e "console.log(require('next/package.json').version)"

node -e "console.log(Object.keys(require('react')))" 2>&1
echo "---experimental---"
node -e "console.log(Object.keys(require('react/experimental')))" 2>&1
echo "---next exp---"
grep -r "viewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null
grep -rl "viewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/server/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null
echo "---next version check for ViewTransition support---"
grep -rl "unstable_ViewTransition\|ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null
find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist -iname "*view-transition*" 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -rl "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -5
echo "---"
grep -o "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/cjs/react.development.js 2>/dev/null | head -3
echo "---check react-dom too---"
grep -rl "addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -5
echo "--- check app dir react resolution ---"
find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled -maxdepth 1 -iname "react*"
grep -n "addTransitionType" -r /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -3
grep -rn "ViewTransition" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

grep -n "ViewTransition\|canary" /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/index.d.ts | head -20
echo "---package json types field---"
cat /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/package.json | grep -A3 '"types"\|"exports"'
echo "---canary.d.ts head---"
sed -n '1,40p' /workspace/node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts
ls -la /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null && cat /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -100
cat .claude/skills/*/SKILL.md 2>/dev/null | head -5; which chromium-cli 2>/dev/null; npx --yes chromium-cli --help 2>&1 | head -20
command -v chromium-cli; echo "exit:$?"; ls /usr/local/bin 2>/dev/null | grep -i chrom; find / -maxdepth 4 -iname "*chromium-cli*" 2>/dev/null

npm ls playwright playwright-core 2>&1 | head -10; find / -maxdepth 6 -iname "*playwright*" -type d 2>/dev/null | grep -v node_modules/.cache | head -20; which google-chrome chromium chromium-browser 2>/dev/null
(npm run dev > /tmp/nextdev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 1; timeout 40 bash -c 'until curl -sf http://localhost:3000 >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 1; done' && echo "UP" || echo "FAILED_TO_START"

echo "--- HOME PAGE ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | head -80
echo "--- PRODUCT PAGE ---"; curl -s http://localhost:3000/product/classic-sneakers | head -80
echo "--- 404 CASE ---"; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/product/does-not-exist
echo "--- server log tail ---"; tail -n 60 /tmp/nextdev.log

grep -o 'vt-name="[^"]*"\|vt-update="[^"]*"\|vt-enter="[^"]*"\|vt-exit="[^"]*"\|vt-share="[^"]*"\|vt-default="[^"]*"' /tmp/nextdev_home.html 2>/dev/null
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ > /tmp/home.html
curl -s http://localhost:3000/product/classic-sneakers > /tmp/detail.html
echo "=== HOME vt attrs ==="
grep -o 'vt-[a-z]*="[^"]*"' /tmp/home.html | sort | uniq -c
echo "=== DETAIL vt attrs ==="
grep -o 'vt-[a-z]*="[^"]*"' /tmp/detail.html | sort | uniq -c
echo "=== product-image-classic-sneakers name match ==="
grep -o 'vt-name="[^"]*classic-sneakers[^"]*"' /tmp/home.html /tmp/detail.html
echo "=== server log (errors?) ==="
grep -i "error\|warn" /tmp/nextdev.log | head -40

echo "=== 404 status ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/product/does-not-exist
echo "=== nav-forward/back class presence in CSS bundle ==="
CSS_URL=$(grep -o '/_next/static/chunks/app_globals[^"]*\.css' /tmp/home.html | head -1)
curl -s "http://localhost:3000$CSS_URL" | grep -o "nav-forward\|nav-back\|prefers-reduced-motion\|via-blur" | sort -u
echo "=== full server log ==="
cat /tmp/nextdev.log
git status --short && echo "--- tsconfig diff ---" && git diff tsconfig.json
cat /workspace/.gitignore 2>/dev/null

lsof -ti:3000 -sTCP:LISTEN 2>/dev/null | xargs -r kill
sleep 1
git status --short
echo "--- restore tsconfig.json to original formatting ---"
git checkout -- tsconfig.json
echo "--- remove generated artifacts not part of the task ---"
rm -rf /workspace/.next /workspace/AGENTS.md /workspace/CLAUDE.md /workspace/next-env.d.ts /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
git status --short
git diff package.json
rm -f /tmp/home.html /tmp/detail.html /tmp/nextdev.log
